Shelters can be reserved from April 1 through October 31. Each reservation covers the shelter and its tables for a four-hour block; the lawns around it stay open to everyone.

Rules for shelter use

Groups of more than sixty people need a special event permit. Amplified sound is allowed until 8 p.m. with the volume kept at a level that does not carry past the shelter lawn.

Please leave the tables and grills clean. Recycling and trash bins are next to every shelter, and the parks crew empties them each morning during the season.

Alcohol is not allowed in any city park. Pets are welcome on a leash of six feet or shorter, and owners must pick up after them.

We confirm reservations by letter within five business days. The parks office answers questions on weekdays from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
